description: The data_contracts section is '_Not specified._'. Without a formal data contract specifying the persisted JSON format (bookmarks.json on disk) and exact API request/response body shapes, there is no baseline schema for ADR-21's forward compatibility decision to reference.
evidence: docs/technical_specification.md lines 152–153: '## Data Contracts\n_Not specified._' The domain_model defines Bookmark fields and api_and_event_contracts describes API shapes, but neither is a formal data contract.
required_remediation: Populate the data_contracts section with the persisted JSON schema for bookmarks.json (an array of objects with id, title, url, tag) and the exact request/response body shapes for each API endpoint.
